snippet.title: Macross 30 gameplay
snippet.description: Didn't think I'd get the game but because I have a really good friend I now own it.  I will get around to uploading all the main quests after I get through the game once to get an idea of where the main quests are.  But for now here's a glimpse of the gameplay.  I do still think the PS2 Macross game has a better Valkyrie feel than this one but since we're never going to get it I'll choose to count my blessings instead and I think that this game's feel is the 2nd best so far.
